sprite.name: LIQUID SNAKE
sprite.incarnation: Original PlayStation 1, shirtless final REX-roof duel

sources.scope: Original PS1 frontal Liquid close-up at REX rooftop, original timer, blond swept-back shoulder-length hair, shirtless torso and dark belt/gloves. Physically inspected against original low-polygon model/HUD. PNG decoded at recording resolution without image transformation; recording is not a native PS1 framebuffer certification.

Original PS1 actual unarmed boss fight, LIFE/LIQUID and original red WARNING timer HUD; bare torso, military trousers, boots, no machine summoned. limits: Entirely redrawn independent native pixel-art bodies of this exact incarnation; no derived pixel filter or source bitmap downsampling.
Retro is an original style adaptation, not an original MSX sprite extraction or hardware palette certification.
Actual source poses are adapted to existing gameplay move keys; every game-specific motion/weapon seam is not claimed as publisher animation extraction.
Runtime and live-match review are required separately after this candidate compilation.
